plan: Model the session as a single public dict with exactly the four contract keys, rebuilt in place (dict.update) on begin/abandon so external references stay valid.

Implement handle() as a dispatcher over the six action types; each handler validates the full action first and only mutates session after validation succeeds (validate-then-commit), so invalid actions cannot corrupt accepted data and never raise.

Centralize screen construction in a helper that returns {prompt, messages, choices} and derives choices purely from the prompt: fresh copies of the appointment list exactly when the prompt is 'Choose appointment', otherwise empty.
Compute post-correction prompts with a next-unmet-prompt resolver: Confirm contact if contact is not confirmed True, else Choose appointment if no appointment is selected, else Review and complete.
Produce error screens with a fixed non-appointment prompt and a first message beginning 'Error:'.

Implement run_once() to raise RuntimeError before touching either port when action_source or screen_sink is missing, then read one action, handle it, display the resulting screen exactly once, and return that same screen object; ports are constructor-injected duck-typed objects so unittest fakes need only read_action() and display().
mechanisms: single mutable session dictionary with in-place reset
centralized screen builder with prompt-driven choice attachment
constructor-injected source/sink ports with precondition check in run_once
